name: Banco Itaú Chile
summary: Banco Itaú Chile provides various banking products and services in Chile and Colombia. It offers savings accounts, time deposits, and checking and current accounts; debit and credit cards; and consumer, mortgage, universal, college, and post graduate credit services, as well as real estate loans. The company also provides corporate, investment, retail, private, and personal banking, as well as treasury and other financial services. In addition, it offers investment, mutual funds, open investment platform, and brokerage services. Further, the company provides auto, home, theft, life, health, and travel insurance. The company was founded in 1871 and is based in Santiago, Chile.
